newsitem.title: USA: Allmerica Financial names Parry CFO.
newsitem.headline: Allmerica Financial names Parry CFO.

text.p: Allmerica Financial Corp said it has named Edward Parry III as vice president and chief financial officer at Allmerica Financial and its two publicly-traded units Allmerica Property & Casualty Cos Inc and Citizens Corp.

Parry succeeds Eric Simonsen, who was promoted to president, Allmerica Services Corp. Allmerica Services provides account processing and customer service for Allmerica Financial's more than two million clients, and corporate support services to all of the Allmerica Financial companies.

Parry joined Allmerica Financial as a merger and acquisition specialist in 1992 and was elected vice president and treasurer in 1993. Before he joined Allmerica Financial, he served in management positions at Price Waterhouse.
